s.en: Please place the embryo on the map.

s.zh: 绑定命匣必须完好，主人必须存活且属于殖民地。
s.en: The bound phylactery must be intact, and the master must be alive and in the colony.

s.zh: 主人统御容量不足；胚体可保留到容量空闲时。
s.en: The master lacks command capacity; the embryo can be kept until capacity frees up.

s.zh: 胚体12格内可用的新鲜生肉不足。
s.en: Not enough fresh raw meat available within 12 cells of the embryo.

s.zh: 胚体12格内可用的钢铁不足。
s.en: Not enough steel available within 12 cells of the embryo.

s.zh: 胚体12格内可用的玻璃钢不足。
s.en: Not enough plasteel available within 12 cells of the embryo.

s.zh: 胚体附近没有可站立位置。
s.en: No standable spot near the embryo.

s.zh: 唤醒失败，追加材料已退回。
\n选择“配置死灵造物”调整初始属性。
s.en: \nChoose "configure necromantic construct" to adjust starting stats.

s.zh: 调整生肉、钢铁和玻璃钢投入，预览属性并唤醒。
s.en: Adjust the raw meat, steel and plasteel invested, preview stats, and awaken.

s.zh: 查看初始材料投入、质量与属性。
s.en: View starting material investment, quality and stats.

s.zh: 到重塑池修改材料、技能兴趣和知识专长。保留经验、关系和植入体。
s.en: Change materials, skill passions and knowledge specialty at the reshaping pool. Keeps XP, relationships and implants.

s.zh: 死灵重塑 · 已有造物
死灵塑形 · 初始配置
死灵造物 · 躯体档案
保留原角色、技能经验、关系和植入体。耗时1日；增加材料补差额，减少不返还，另消耗50生肉。
s.en: Keeps the original character, skill XP, relationships and implants. Takes 1 day; added materials pay the difference, removed ones aren't refunded, and 50 raw meat is also consumed.

s.zh: 先塑造躯体，再赋予灵魂。调整投入即可预览结果；保存方案不扣材料。
s.en: Shape the body first, then grant the soul. Adjust the investment to preview the result; saving a plan doesn't deduct materials.

s.zh: 初始配置已固定，以下为本个体的材料与强化记录。
s.en: The initial configuration is fixed; below are this individual's material and reinforcement records.

s.zh: 旧版造物：未记录历史材料投入
s.en: Old construct: no historical material investment recorded

s.zh: 生肉 · 强化生命上限
钢铁 · 增加护甲，略降低移动速度
s.en: Steel · adds armor, slightly lowers move speed

s.zh: 玻璃钢 · 精密骨架与魂能传导
s.en: Plasteel · precision skeleton and soul conduction

s.zh: 低成本躯体：可以承担全部殖民者工作，并正常学习。
s.en: Low-cost body: can do all colonist work and learns normally.

s.zh: 攻坚躯体：可以承担全部殖民者工作。血肉维护与统御规则保持不变。
s.en: Assault body: can do all colonist work. Flesh upkeep and command rules are unchanged.

s.zh:
数值相对该类型的基础属性。
知识死灵另享主人心灵敏感度加成。
知识死灵技能固定，工作经验100%回馈主人。
s.en:
Values are relative to this type's base stats.
Knowledge necros also get a bonus from the master's psychic sensitivity.
Knowledge necro skills are fixed; 100% of work XP goes back to the master.

s.zh: 唤醒吸收12格内可达、未禁用的材料。
s.en: Awakening absorbs reachable, unforbidden materials within 12 cells.
